formal.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

ordinary.scope: Actual first six public observations, endpoint/prefix/receipt bindings only; original private diagnostics are not parsed and no gameplay or gate mathematics is replayed.

independentAudit.method: Original raw inputs independently determine neutral/epoch gates, direction and button edges. Only fresh-input times and absolute beat boundaries form the queue transaction calendar. FIFO identities drive one public-grid classification per beat; integer modular gates and actual arrival prefixes determine marker ownership, score and the first terminal. Every actual frame/lastStep/receipt is compared; no Model/pilot import, route search, new gameplay or empty-tick game-state replay.
limitations: Only the approved first six public ordinary cases. Formal synthetic boundaries, browser controller/pause/disconnect/retry and recording evidence are separate.

This corpus contains valid fixed positive-dt playing calls. Invalid dt, gaps, calls after an observed terminal or frames past the independently derived first terminal are rejected; invalid-dt and post-terminal no-op behavior is not claimed as ordinary coverage.

Full-capacity, undo, simultaneous edits, same-boundary enqueue/consume, invalid input, cancel reentry and final-budget victory/hazard are counted only when actually observed; no fixtures or extra routes are created.
An optional terminal observation timing acknowledges an existing terminal receipt and applies no input. It is bound separately and never counted as a new interval.
All integer identities, clocks, coordinates, gate residues and priorities use exact comparison with no epsilon. Numeric error is reported in each original field unit; elapsed derives from tick/60.

Only queueReceipts and beatReceipts are prefix encoded. Mutable queue/player/markers/input/last fields remain full actual observations; serialized equality cannot prove object identity or Object.freeze.

Production/pilot/raw diagnostic-bearing originals are not read. Their byte identities and ordinary source window are bound through the root-approved public projection; no future-route or feasibility material is used.

gameRules.scope: Formal isolated boundaries, six ordinary-input games and independent gate/queue audit are separate evidence. Packaging binds saved endpoints and receipts without replaying navigation or periodic gate physics.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

cancel isolates new held edges while real queued waits and the single beat clock continue; only full neutral rearms
disconnect freezes the entire model; reconnect requires explicit resume and full neutral while queued waits resume on the existing beat clock
P freezes the full queue and fractional beat phase; the 960 glass fits and stale held input stays isolated after resume
ordinary L1 public inputs naturally attempt a closed gate and lose at the real consuming beat
R restores the same public map, empty queue and receipts, and the real initial beat phase prefix
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryMetronomeTraversal.scope: Actual keyboard dispatch edges including menu navigation, permanent queue/beat receipts and sparse tick/beat/position/gate endpoints. Raw key counts are not accepted-command counts. Complete saved receipts may include transient last events never sampled; those gaps remain explicit. Observed lastStep values are actual full one-tick calls, including input quarantine and terminal calls. No missing input, interval, gate transition or route is replayed. Real controller-page integration and the ordinary independent audit remain separate evidence.

encodingOrderEvidence.scope: Original reception order and frame bytes retained; encoding order is stable by actual recorded timestamp with reception-index ties. Consolidation synthesizes no state or frame.

actualGameplay.scope: Actual browser input, permanent queue/beat receipts and sparse tick, beat, queue, player and gate observations. Raw key dispatch counts include menu navigation and are not accepted-command counts. Missing local events and sample gaps remain explicit; no input, path or model replay occurs. The ordinary independent audit is separate. The approved recipe, observed win and at least eleven seconds of actual terminal hold are bound. Actual controller-page/WebSocket integration is separately recorded alongside controlled TV-bridge fixtures; neither proves physical hardware. Original reception order, derived encoding mapping and real empty error arrays remain factual. The existing full decode is reused once; no recording recovery is assumed.

controllerTransportEvidence.scope: Browser-emulated joystick plus upper WAIT A / lower UNDO B contacts produce trusted PointerEvents on the unchanged signed-asset controller.html/js; the controlled WebSocket server records actual outgoing strings. Held checks prove stable transport without release/repress, not queue effects or Model fresh handling. TV input-bridge/model checks are separate; no physical phone hardware or production Android server is tested.
controllerTransportEvidence.controlledTvBridgeScope: Actual WS packet values are transferred through the explicit controlled TV snapshot bridge. This is not a production Android room server or a physical phone. Original controller transport timestamps are not replayed as a gameplay timing route.

actualGameplay.browserScope: First shared10, UI8 and QR1 passed. Actual controller-page transport and explicitly controlled TV packet transfers are separate scopes; QR data is a layout fixture, with no physical hardware or production Android end-to-end claim.

liveObservationWindows.name: 05-actual-queued-direction
liveObservationWindows.scope: Real continuous before/after window with actually released keys. Beat clock, queued consumption, position and terminal phase may advance naturally. Capture issues no input. Permanent receipts prove earlier gate entries or marker collection, not an instantaneous screenshot event. Neither endpoint substitutes for pixels; no pause, state injection or time freeze.

candidateEvidence.scope: Actual sparse public snapshots and permanent queue/beat receipts only; not a full 60Hz browser stream. Beat timing follows the actual model tick; no second clock or wall-time-derived movement is assumed. Live captures use complete input neutral while the actual queued path continues. One-command ordinary play does not prove capacity-six or successful undo. Native Enter prefix is keyboard integration, not physical-phone evidence.

limitations: No physical Android installation or TV/phone execution is certified by this artifact check.
Visual review and unique gameplay assertions are separate required checks.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
